simple.meaning: בֶּשֶׂם (besem) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “fragrance ; by implication, spicery ; also the balsam plant.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 29 times across Exodus, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, 1 Chronicles, 2 Chronicles, and 4 more, beginning at Exodus 25:6. Its contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֶּשֶׂם (H1314).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
